confirmedCurrentSources.role: current municipal housing policy/programme; not a house-stock permit ordinance

confirmedCurrentSources.title: Current Alphen-Chaam local-regulations index
confirmedCurrentSources.role: official index checked for current local regulations

findings: No current Alphen-Chaam Huisvestingsverordening or dedicated opkoopbescherming/verhuurvergunning/woonruimtevoorraad ordinance was established in the official local-regulations review.
The current Programma Wonen is an Omgevingswet programme and cannot be used as evidence that a specific address is free of spatial or use restrictions.
For conversion, splitting, room rental or other use changes the applicable omgevingsplan must still be checked at address level.
Absence of a dedicated housing-stock ordinance in this review is not a negative legal conclusion about every possible local restriction.

findings: No current dedicated Altena Huisvestingsverordening or opkoopbescherming regime was established in the official searches performed for this review.

Altena does have current housing-related rules and policies, including the Omgevingsplan and labour-migrant housing policy, so room rental, splitting and use changes require address/use-specific spatial assessment.
The absence of a current dedicated Huisvestingsverordening in these searches must not be translated into an unrestricted-permitted conclusion.
